CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_AnalizaVanzari
    @AnCalcular INT,
    @PragMinim DECIMAL(18,2)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- [SIMULARE TABELE FIZICE]
    CREATE TABLE #Orders (
        OrderID INT,
        CustomerID INT,
        TotalAmount DECIMAL(18,2),
        OrderDate DATETIME
    );

    CREATE TABLE #Customers (
        CustomerID INT,
        CustomerName NVARCHAR(100),
        Country NVARCHAR(50)
    );

    -- [POPULARE DATE TEST]
    INSERT INTO #Customers (CustomerID, CustomerName, Country) VALUES
    (1, 'Client ABC', 'Romania'),
    (2, 'Client XYZ', 'Germania'),
    (3, 'Client 123', 'Romania');

    INSERT INTO #Orders (OrderID, CustomerID, TotalAmount, OrderDate) VALUES
    (101, 1, 550.00, DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 5, 10)),
    (102, 1, 1200.00, DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 6, 12)), -- Cea mai recenta comanda pt Client 1
    (103, 2, 450.00, DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 2, 15)),  -- Singura comanda pt Client 2
    (104, 3, 2000.00, DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular - 1, 12, 1)); -- Comanda veche din alt an

    -- [LOGICA PROCEDURII]
    WITH VanzariPartitionate AS (
        SELECT 
            CustomerID,
            OrderID,
            TotalAmount,
            OrderDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC) AS Rownum
        FROM #Orders
        WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = @AnCalcular
    ),
    ClientiFiltrați AS (
        SELECT 
            c.CustomerID,
            c.CustomerName,
            c.Country,
            vp.TotalAmount,
            vp.OrderDate
        FROM #Customers c
        INNER JOIN VanzariPartitionate vp ON c.CustomerID = vp.CustomerID
        WHERE vp.Rownum = 1 AND vp.TotalAmount >= @PragMinim
    )
    SELECT 
        CustomerName,
        Country,
        TotalAmount,
        OrderDate,
        SUM(TotalAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS TotalPeTara
    FROM ClientiFiltrați
    ORDER BY Country, TotalAmount DESC;

    -- Curățare tabele temporare
    DROP TABLE #Orders;
    DROP TABLE #Customers;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_CaseB_Imbricat
    @Tip INT,
    @Sub INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN @Tip = 1 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN @Sub = 1 THEN 'Tip1-Sub1'
                    WHEN @Sub = 2 THEN 'Tip1-Sub2'
                    ELSE 'Tip1-Necunoscut'
                END
            WHEN @Tip = 2 THEN 'Tip2'
            ELSE 'Necunoscut'
        END AS Rezultat;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_FormatareDate
    @IDClient INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- [SIMULARE TABELE FIZICE]
    CREATE TABLE #DateClienti (
        IDClient INT,
        Nume NVARCHAR(50),
        Prenume NVARCHAR(50),
        Telefon VARCHAR(20),
        DataNastere DATE,
        Gen CHAR(1)
    );

    -- Simulare rezultat funcție inline "fn_ObtineConturiClient"
    CREATE TABLE #ConturiClient (
        IDClient INT,
        NumarCont VARCHAR(34),
        Activ BIT
    );

    -- [POPULARE DATE TEST]
    INSERT INTO #DateClienti (IDClient, Nume, Prenume, Telefon, DataNastere, Gen) VALUES
    (1, 'Popescu', 'Ion', '0722111222', '1990-05-15', 'M'),
    (2, 'Ionescu', 'Maria', '0733444555', '1995-10-20', 'F');

    INSERT INTO #ConturiClient (IDClient, NumarCont, Activ) VALUES
    (1, 'RO12BANC9876543210', 1),
    (1, 'RO12BANC1111111111', 0),
    (2, 'RO12BANC2222222222', 1);

    -- [LOGICA PROCEDURII]
    SELECT 
        IDClient,
        UPPER(Nume) + ' ' + UPPER(Prenume) AS NumeComplet,
        Telefon,
        -- În loc de dbo.fn_CalculeazaVarsta(DataNastere), calculăm direct inline pentru simulare:
        DATEDIFF(hour, DataNastere, GETDATE()) / 8766 AS VarstaCurenta,
        CASE 
            WHEN Gen = 'M' THEN 'Masculin'
            WHEN Gen = 'F' THEN 'Feminin'
            ELSE 'Nespecificat'
        END AS GenDescriere,
        -- În loc de dbo.fn_ObtineConturiClient(IDClient), interogăm tabelul temporar asociat:
        (SELECT TOP 1 NumarCont FROM #ConturiClient WHERE IDClient = c.IDClient AND Activ = 1) AS ContPrincipal
    FROM #DateClienti c
    WHERE IDClient = @IDClient;

    DROP TABLE #DateClienti;
    DROP TABLE #ConturiClient;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_AnalizaVanzari
    @AnCalcular INT,
    @PragMinim DECIMAL(18,2)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- [SIMULARE TABELE FIZICE]
    CREATE TABLE #Orders (
        OrderID INT,
        CustomerID INT,
        TotalAmount DECIMAL(18,2),
        Status NVARCHAR(50),
        OrderDate DATETIME
    );

    CREATE TABLE #Customers (
        CustomerID INT,
        CustomerName NVARCHAR(100),
        Country NVARCHAR(50)
    );

    -- [POPULARE DATE TEST]
    INSERT INTO #Customers (CustomerID, CustomerName, Country) VALUES
    (1, 'Client ABC', 'Romania'),
    (2, 'Client XYZ', 'Germania'),
    (3, 'Client 123', 'Romania');

    INSERT INTO #Orders (OrderID, CustomerID, TotalAmount, Status, OrderDate) VALUES
    (101, 1, 550.00, 'Completed', DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 5, 10)),
    (102, 1, 1200.00, 'Completed', DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 6, 12)),
    (103, 2, 450.00, 'Cancelled', DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular, 2, 15)), -- Anulată (va fi filtrată în Țintă)
    (104, 3, 2000.00, 'Completed', DATEFROMPARTS(@AnCalcular - 1, 12, 1));

    -- [LOGICA PROCEDURII]
    WITH VanzariPartitionate AS (
        select 
            CustomerID,
            OrderID,
            TotalAmount,
            Status,
            OrderDate,
            row_number() over (partition by CustomerID order by OrderDate desc) as Rn
        from #Orders
        where year(OrderDate) = @AnCalcular and Status <> 'Cancelled'
    ),
    ClientiFiltrați AS (
        select 
            cust.CustomerID,
            cust.CustomerName,
            cust.Country,
            vp.TotalAmount,
            vp.OrderDate
        from #Customers cust
        inner join VanzariPartitionate vp on cust.CustomerID = vp.CustomerID
        where vp.Rn = 1 and vp.TotalAmount > @PragMinim
    )
    select 
        CustomerName,
        Country,
        TotalAmount,
        OrderDate,
        sum(TotalAmount) over (partition by Country) as TotalPeTara,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as DataInterogare
    from ClientiFiltrați
    order by Country, TotalAmount desc;

    DROP TABLE #Orders;
    DROP TABLE #Customers;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_CaseB_Imbricat
    @Tip INT,
    @Sub INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN @Tip = 1 THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN @Sub = 1 THEN 'Tip1-Sub1-Modificat'
                    WHEN @Sub = 2 THEN 'Tip1-Sub2'
                    WHEN @Sub = 3 THEN 'Tip1-Sub3-Nou'
                    ELSE 'Tip1-Necunoscut'
                END
            WHEN @Tip = 2 THEN 'Tip2-Modificat'
            ELSE 'Necunoscut-Sau-Null'
        END AS Rezultat;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_CaseE_CTEMultiplu
    @An INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    CREATE TABLE #Vanzari (ID INT, Suma DECIMAL(18,2), An INT, Activ BIT);

    WITH VanzariAn AS (
        SELECT
            ID,
            Suma,
            Activ
        FROM #Vanzari
        WHERE An = @An AND Activ = 1
    ),
    TotalGeneral AS (
        SELECT SUM(Suma) AS Total, COUNT(*) AS NrInregistrari
        FROM VanzariAn
    )
    SELECT
        v.ID,
        v.Suma,
        t.Total,
        t.NrInregistrari
    FROM VanzariAn v
    CROSS JOIN TotalGeneral t;

    DROP TABLE #Vanzari;
END;

CREATE   PROC dbo.TESTSIMILITUDINE_FormatareDate
    @IDClient INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- [SIMULARE TABELE FIZICE]
    CREATE TABLE #DateClienti (
        IDClient INT,
        Nume NVARCHAR(50),
        Prenume NVARCHAR(50),
        Telefon VARCHAR(20),
        DataNastere DATE,
        Gen CHAR(1)
    );

    CREATE TABLE #ConturiClient (
        IDClient INT,
        NumarCont VARCHAR(34),
        Activ BIT
    );

    -- [POPULARE DATE TEST]
    INSERT INTO #DateClienti (IDClient, Nume, Prenume, Telefon, DataNastere, Gen) VALUES
    (1, 'Popescu', 'Ion', '0722111222', '1990-05-15', 'M'),
    (2, 'Ionescu', 'Maria', '0733444555', '1995-10-20', 'F');

    INSERT INTO #ConturiClient (IDClient, NumarCont, Activ) VALUES
    (1, 'RO12BANC9876543210', 1),
    (2, 'RO12BANC2222222222', 1);

    -- [LOGICA PROCEDURII]
    SELECT 
        IDClient,
        CONCAT(UPPER(Nume), ' ', UPPER(Prenume)) AS NumeComplet,
        Telefon,
        DATEDIFF(year, DataNastere, GETDATE()) AS VarstaCalculataDirect,
        CASE 
            WHEN Gen = 'F' THEN 'Feminin'
            WHEN Gen = 'M' THEN 'Masculin'
            ELSE 'Incomplet'
        END AS GenDescriere,
        (SELECT TOP 1 NumarCont FROM #ConturiClient WHERE IDClient = c.IDClient AND Activ = 1) AS ContPrincipal
    FROM #DateClienti c
    WHERE IDClient = @IDClient;

    DROP TABLE #DateClienti;
    DROP TABLE #ConturiClient;
END;
